The correct answer is A: unlawful homicide committed by a minister as an organ of the state is a public act (jure imperii). Acts performed in the exercise of governmental authority are acta jure imperii, and their unlawful character leaves that sovereign classification intact, as in Jurisdictional Immunities of the State (Germany v. Italy) and Jones v. Saudi Arabia. The classification follows from the official, governmental character of the act.

CONFIDENCE: 66
